      "snippet": "Yes — we can make this fast without changing (or weakening) the governed build/ship process.
Why it “took forever”
What you saw was repeated full-tree scans (ZIP contents + extracted filesystem + manifests + doctrine checks). That’s inherently slower than “look up the answer” because there was no single authoritative lookup map inside the bundle.
The fix
I added a deterministic, hash-backed system index that lives inside the OS:

SYSTEM_INDEX.json (root)

Every file path in the bundle
